checks.name: first use and sample deck
checks.detail: an empty shelf offered the sample deck and named the companion commands; starting the sample saved it and listed its deck

checks.name: reveal and grade every card
checks.detail: all six sample cards revealed and graded Good, including the Japanese greeting and the long multi-sentence answer, ending on the Review complete screen

checks.name: review log persistence
checks.detail: six Good reviews were appended to cobalt-review-log.ndjson beside the collection, and after a simulator restart the recorded cards stayed done instead of coming up again

checks.name: companion import over the sample
checks.detail: the real flashcards-import helper converted an original three-card package, the CLI verified it, the staged bundle replaced the sample collection and one more Good review appended to the untouched earlier log

checks.name: media cards through the companion pair
checks.detail: a second package carrying an embedded PNG merged through the CLI into a six-card collection; the media card revealed and graded on the simulator with its image on screen
